nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Carbon capture and storage|Carbon capture retrofitting_qna_003
nodes.question: How much can emissions be reduced by activity-related measures alone, and what additional reduction is achieved when fleet-related measures are included?
nodes.answer: Emissions could be reduced to 5.1 to 4.8 million tonnes of CO2 equivalents (-26.1 % to -30.4 %) by activity-related measures alone. When fleet-related measures are included, emissions can be further reduced to 0.4 million tonnes of CO2 equivalents (-94.2 %).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Carbon capture and storage|Carbon capture retrofitting_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What does the author suggest about the perception of CLSC benefits in relation to carbon emissions?
nodes.answer: The author suggests that there is a mere perception of benefits associated with CLSCs regardless of real outcomes, as these facilities have been shown to contribute to carbon emissions due to remanufacturing processes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Carbon capture and storage|Carbon capture retrofitting_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why were the performances of factories A, B, and C underrated in terms of sustainability scores?
nodes.answer: The performances of factories A, B, and C were underrated because they lacked effective monitoring systems for total greenhouse gas generation and emissions as well as any reduction plans. 4th, 6th, and 7th parameters were not scored for those factories.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does the updated DSK model enhance the original framework?
nodes.answer: The updated DSK model includes scenarios involving an emission trading system (ETS) and operational permit systems, as well as allowing for endogenous adaptation in R&D and machinery replacement routines.
